stations.title: Kofi
stations.say: A family is one booking to me.

stations.title: The API
stations.text: Books one name at a time, even when full.

captions: Kofi saw a family of four split up when only two places were left.
The API books one name at a time and never says that a workshop is full.
You refuse a full workshop, decide about a whole group and undo a half-done one.
Four names for three places are refused together, and nobody is booked alone.
A booking goes in whole or not at all, even when the database fails halfway.
